policies.title: Cheapest capable model first, no silent premium fallback
policies.description: Model selection uses the cheapest model tier capable of the task. AUTO_PREMIUM_FALLBACK is false; escalation to a higher tier requires explicit policy/budget authorization.

policies.title: Git automation safety
policies.description: Automated Git transport may perform safe fetch, fast-forward-only sync, commit verification, push and remote SHA verification. Force push, hard reset, automatic rebase and silent history rewrite are forbidden; local/remote divergence fails closed.

policies.title: No real secrets in the repository
policies.description: No real secret is committed. .env.example contains placeholders only; a historically exposed secret must be revoked, rotated and replaced.

policies.title: Two-snapshot independent review lifecycle
policies.description: Independent review targets a stable reviewed commit that is not modified during review. Closure requires authentic independent evidence rather than the builder's own assertion.

policies.title: Scope discipline: one phase/milestone contract at a time
policies.description: Implementation stays inside the current milestone contract. Future phases are not implemented early merely because their folders exist, and unrelated ideas are routed to backlog.

policies.title: Evidence over claim
policies.description: PASS, CLEAN, Founder-approved or review-complete statuses cannot become true merely because a caller writes those strings into a file; execution and review evidence must carry trustworthy provenance.
